datasets.help: The row with the category column, the optional value column and the optional group column, each column described individually under keys. The category column is required for a chart. To clear, set one empty row ([{ x: null, y: null, g: null }]); [] is rejected.

x.label: X
x.title: Category column (X axis)
x.help: The category column (slot x); its values become the ranked bars. Required, empty until one is chosen.

y.label: Y
y.title: Value column (numeric, optional — sum per category)
y.help: The value column (slot y), numeric and optional; without it each bar counts the rows of its category. Empty until one is chosen.

g.label: G
g.title: Grouping (optional, stacked Pareto)
g.help: The stacking column (slot g), optional; it stacks each bar by its values. Empty until one is chosen.

aggregation.help: How the values of the value column are combined per category: sum or mean. Takes effect only with a value column (slot y); without it each category counts its rows.

stats.help: The ranked Pareto table, each figure described individually under keys; null while there is no data (no category column, no values or a chosen column not readable).

activeParams.help: The fields that take effect in the current state: aggregation only with a value column (slot y) set.

activeColumnSlots.help: The slot keys a row of the datasets carries: x, y, g.

chartData.help: The entries (name, value, colour) or, with a group column, the categories and groups (name, values per category, colour) from the chosen columns, as the chart draws them; empty while there is no data.

ParetoStats.rows: The categories in descending order of value, as the table shows them. With a stacking column the value is the sum over all stacks. The chart's collective category Other is not listed here; the table lists every category individually.
ParetoStats.total: The sum of all values, negative ones count as 0; the basis of the cumulative share.

ParetoRow.name: The category.
ParetoRow.value: The value of the category: without a value column the number of rows, otherwise the sum or mean of the value column; with a stack column the sum of the stack values. The table column changes its header with the aggregation (Count, Sum, Mean).
ParetoRow.cumPct: The cumulative share up to and including this row of the sum of all values, in percent from 0 to 100; the table shows it with a percent sign.
